content.title: Pranksters Are Sharing Their Favorite April Fool's Pranks (30 Pics)
content.text: April Fool’s Day is the only day we’ve all agreed it’s socially acceptable to prank someone, whether or not the victim sees it coming. In most cases, April Fool’s Pranks are harmless and lighthearted, but I’ve seen some pretty elaborate pranks in my day. If you’re looking for some inspiration, people are sharing their best April Fool’s pranks they came up with. 1. The Non-Prank Donut Prank via reddit Ernesto Andrade “Bring a box of creme-filled donuts to work. Regular creme-filled donuts. Put a note on the box that says “Happy April 1!” Watch everyone get paranoid about what you didn’t actually do to the donuts.” 2. A Prank Fit For A 5-Year-Old via reddit puuikibeach “Here’s one my 5 year old daughter pulled on me: For a few days leading up to the 1st, she was talking about how her and mommy were going to bake me brownies. Totally hyped it up. I should have seen it coming, but on April Fool’s Day, she brings me a plate with a bunch of brown construction paper cut out letter E’s. She made me brown E’s.” 3. “Drink” Some Cleaning Solution via reddit Arria Belli “I did this one last year. I work at a restaurant. We have these spray bottles with a light pink solution we use to clean tables and such. I went and grabbed a brand new one and filled it with watered down pink lemonade. I would be cleaning near my co workers , while chatting with them and nonchalantly unscrew the top spray/ trigger piece and just started downing it like I was dying of thirst. The look of horror on some of their faces was priceless.” 4. Fake Moustache via reddit Joe Goldberg I’m a female kindergarten teacher. I wore a mustache all day long and pretended it wasn’t there…even with the parents. Everyone got a kick out of it except for one student who cried because I “looked scary.” 5. “Use Other Door” via reddit Taz There are 4 doors to our building and my co-worker put a sign on each one that says “Door broken use other door” with an arrow pointing left. 6. Mouse Trap via reddit Erin Kohlenberg piece of opaque tape over the laser on everyone’s mouse. IT was pretty angry, I need to take that one to the grave with me. 7. “Slash” A Tire via reddit glowingforest Put a picture of Slash from Guns n Roses on a coworker’s tires and tell them you slashed their tires 8. “nCage It” via reddit rmak321 If they use Google Chrome, install the extension “nCage It”. It changes EVERY image (including google logo, thumbnails, etc.) into randomly generated pics/gifs of Nicholas Cage. The best part? There is an option to hide the extension from the task bar. They would actually have to go into their internet options and find it under the “extensions” tab just to turn it off. It’s great. 9. The Chia Keyboard via reddit generalising Here’s what I’ve got planned: Got the IT guy to give me a broken keyboard. I’m going to take a bunch of chia seeds, plaster them underneath the keys, spend a few days watering it, and then switch it for my coworker’s keyboard that morning. 10. The Broken Toilet Seat via reddit Put dry macaroni under the toilet seat, so it’ll sound like the toilet breaks when someone sits on it. 11. Zip Ties Everywhere! via reddit donkeyboxx My favorite I did is to zip tie the cabinets and fridge shut. Then when they go to get the scissors, they find it they are zip tied shut too. Make sure to have an extra pair… I forgot to do that last year and had to buy another one… 12. Googly Eyes Never Fail via reddit Geoff Greer We put googly eyes on everything in the fridge to shock the kids in the morning. We thought it was freakin hilarious and were totally impressed with our cleverness. Our kids were not impressed in the slightest. Not sure they even noticed…. Next year, we made them cereal and milk with a spoon in the bowl and put it in the freezer overnight. When we gave them breakfast, one burst into tears and the other threw it on the floor. Our kids can’t hang 🙁 13. “Sorry About The Damage” via reddit Sergey Rodovnichenko Put notes on people’s cars telling them “sorry about the damage”. They will spend forever looking for it. 14. Fake Desktop via reddit Mark Ordonez Take screenshot of desktop. Remove all icons on desktop. Close all applications. Set taskbar to “auto-hide”. Set screenshot as wallpaper. Result: computer looks just as they left it, but when they try to do anything, it doesn’t work. 15. The Water Hose via reddit Bill Smith Open up the spray option on your kitchen sink, aim at face. Gets the wife every year. Protip: don’t forget you did it the night before: I get myself every year as well. 16. “Subtle But Sweet” via reddit Kara Babcock Move every piece of furniture 2 inches to the right. Subtle but sweet. 17. “Play Nickelback” via reddit Kai Hendry Create scheduled tasks on their computer to play an annoying song, at an annoying time. We did this to a co-worker. Every day, 1:15, his computer would start to play Nickelback. 3:45, Taylor Swift. 18. via reddit Stefan Day before April Fools during my highschool years I tell my parents that “school was cancelled”. Tomorrow during the middle of the school day I say “April Fools”. Oddly enough I wasn’t met with the laughs I was expecting. 19. Mashed Potato Ice Cream via reddit Phil Roeder Freeze mashed potatoes. Scoop frozen mashed onto cones. Serve the kids vanilla ice cream cones for dessert. The look on their faces after they take a big bite is amazing! Cheap, funny and harmless. 20. April Birthday via reddit English106 Pulled this on my wife two years ago. I logged into her Facebook and changed her birthday to April 1st. Wishes came flooding in. 21. “Please follow up with Mr. Bear at…” via reddit Phil Roeder I work in Sales, and it seems like we always have a new guy around April. I like to write down on a post it “Please follow up with Mr. Bear at…” and then the number for the San Francisco zoo. 22. Instant Shakespeare via reddit Melina Sampaio Manfrinatti Got this from Rooster Teeth years ago, but it works wonders. Get a group of friends together and start texting a specific person with everything in ‘quotes.’ Don’t say any about, don’t even acknowledge it. Then the next day suddenly stop. 23. via reddit Dave I have a key to the vending machine at work. I’ve been wanting to buy a bunch of bananas and replace all the chips and candy with them. 25. Trail Mix…But Different via reddit Mike Mozart At the office, fill a bowl with trail mix, but remove all M&M’s and replace with Skittles. 26. Rearranged Keyboard Keys via reddit Adikos My mom used to be a hunt-and-peck typer, so one year I pried all the keys off of her keyboard and re-arranged them in alphabetical order. She got pretty mad, but she decided that maybe she should learn to type properly, so she did. That prank wouldn’t work today. 27. “Chocolate Rain, Some Stay Dry And Others Feel The Pain” via reddit F_A Take off the lid to the shower drain. Shove in a plastic bag with some chocolate milk powder mix in it. Secure the bag with the drain cover and cut off any excess bits of plastic. Wait for sounds of disgust as brown water starts coming up from the drain while they’re showering. 28. Mayo Everywhere via reddit ortolina A few years ago I bought 200 packets of mayonnaise and hid them all over my boyfriend at the time’s room. I tucked them in the pockets of all his clothes, in his board games, behind his wall art- anywhere you could think of there was mayonnaise. He was still finding mayo a couple years later. 29. Replace A Liquid With Lube via reddit Mike Mozart Replace their Purell with Lube. Watch them rub their hands together forever. The lube washes off harmlessly, the shame never will. h/t: BoredPanda Nate writes for Pleated-Jeans and enjoys finding the internet’s funniest corners so you don’t have to.
